cases.sentence: ___ сказал Иакову, «Возвращайся в землю отцов к своей родне, и я буду с тобой».
cases.translation: The Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers, to your relatives, and I will be with you."
cases.explain: Господь is the subject performing the action сказал ("said"), so the verb's subject takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Иаков забрал все, чем владел наш отец, и скопил себе богатство за счёт нашего ___.
cases.translation: Jacob has taken all that our father owned, and accumulated wealth at the expense of our father.
cases.explain: The compound preposition за счёт ("at the expense of") governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Иаков был вне себя от ___ и стал выговаривать Лавану.
cases.translation: Jacob was beside himself with anger and began to reproach Laban.
cases.explain: The preposition от ("from/out of") governs the genitive case, expressing the cause of his state — от гнева.

cases.sentence: Лаван сказал ___, «Что ты сделал? Ты обманул меня и увел моих дочерей, как пленников на войне».
cases.translation: Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? You deceived me and carried off my daughters like captives of war."
cases.explain: The verb сказал ("said") takes an indirect object in the dative case — сказал кому? Иакову.

cases.sentence: Иаков отправился в путь к своему ___ Исааку в землю Ханаана.
cases.translation: Jacob set out on the way to his father Isaac, to the land of Canaan.
cases.explain: The preposition к ("toward") governs the dative case, showing motion toward a person — к отцу.

cases.sentence: Возвращайся в ___ отцов к своей родне, и я буду с тобой».
cases.translation: Return to the land of your fathers, to your relatives, and I will be with you.
cases.explain: The preposition в + accusative case expresses motion into a destination — в землю.

cases.translation: Laban makes a covenant with Jacob.
cases.explain: The preposition с ("with") governs the instrumental case — с Иаковом.

cases.sentence: Иаков уже поставил шатер в Нагорье Галаада, и Лаван с ___ тоже стали там лагерем.
cases.translation: Jacob had already pitched his tent in the mountain of Gilead, and Laban with his relatives also camped there.
cases.explain: The preposition с ("with") governs the instrumental case — с родней.

cases.sentence: Таковы были те двадцать лет, что я жил в твоём ___.
cases.translation: Those were the twenty years that I lived in your house.
cases.explain: The preposition в + prepositional case expresses location, not motion — жил в доме.

reading.ru: Иаков услышал, как сыновья Лавана говорили
reading.question: What did Jacob overhear Laban's sons saying about him?
options: That he had taken all that belonged to their father and grown rich from it
That he was planning to return to Canaan
That Laban wanted to make a covenant with him
That Rachel had stolen the household idols
reading.correct: That he had taken all that belonged to their father and grown rich from it
reading.explain: The sons of Laban complained that Jacob had taken their father's wealth and grown rich at his expense.

reading.ru: Господь сказал Иакову, «Возвращайся в землю отцов к своей родне, и я буду с тобой».
reading.question: What did the Lord command Jacob to do?
options: Return to the land of his fathers and his relatives
reading.correct: Return to the land of his fathers and his relatives
reading.explain: The Lord told Jacob to return to the land of his fathers, promising to be with him.

reading.ru: Но Бог не дал меня ему в обиду».
reading.question: According to Jacob, even though Laban deceived him and changed his wages, what did God do?
options: God did not allow Laban to harm him
God gave Jacob's wages to Laban
God sent an angel to kill Laban's flocks
reading.correct: God did not allow Laban to harm him
reading.explain: Jacob tells Rachel and Leah that God did not let Laban hurt him despite the repeated deception.

reading.ru: Если он говорил, «Платы твоей будут крапчатые», то весь скот рождал крапчатых, а если он говорил, «Платы твоей будут пестрые», то весь скот рождал пестрых.
reading.question: What happened to the flocks according to what Laban named as Jacob's wages?
options: Whatever pattern Laban named as wages, the whole flock bore offspring in that pattern
The flocks all died of disease
The flocks multiplied without any pattern
Jacob's flocks were taken away by Laban's sons
reading.correct: Whatever pattern Laban named as wages, the whole flock bore offspring in that pattern
reading.explain: Whenever Laban specified speckled or streaked animals as Jacob's wages, the flock produced offspring matching that description, showing God's provision.

reading.ru: Ангел Бога сказал мне во сне, «Иаков».
reading.question: Who spoke to Jacob in his dream?
reading.explain: Jacob recounts that the angel of God addressed him by name in a dream.

reading.ru: Я бог Вифиля, где ты возлил масло на памятник и поклялся мне.
reading.question: What had Jacob done at Bethel, according to the angel?
options: Poured oil on a pillar and made a vow
Built a house for his family
reading.correct: Poured oil on a pillar and made a vow
reading.explain: The angel identifies himself as the God of Bethel, where Jacob anointed a pillar with oil and made a vow.

reading.ru: Да есть ли у нас еще доли в наследстве Отца?
reading.question: What complaint do Rachel and Leah raise about their father's inheritance?
options: They feel they have no remaining share or inheritance from their father
They feel Laban owes them more sheep
They want Jacob to divide his wealth between them
They complain that Laban favors Rachel over Leah
reading.correct: They feel they have no remaining share or inheritance from their father
reading.explain: Rachel and Leah ask rhetorically whether they still have any portion or inheritance in their father's estate, implying they have none.

reading.ru: Иаков посадил детей и жен на верблюдов, погнал весь скот впереди себя
reading.question: How did Jacob prepare to leave Laban's household?
options: He put his children and wives on camels and drove his livestock ahead of him
He sold all his flocks to Laban
He left his family behind and traveled alone
He waited for Laban's permission to depart
reading.correct: He put his children and wives on camels and drove his livestock ahead of him
reading.explain: Jacob set his children and wives on camels and drove his flocks ahead as he departed for Canaan.

reading.ru: Когда Лаван ушел стричь овец, Рахиль украла его башков
reading.question: What did Rachel do while Laban was away shearing his sheep?
options: She stole her father's household idols
She freed all of Laban's servants
She told Jacob to stay behind
reading.correct: She stole her father's household idols
reading.explain: While Laban was occupied shearing sheep, Rachel stole his household idols.

reading.ru: Но ночью Бог явился Арамею Лавану во сне и сказал ему, «Берегись, не говори ничего Иакову, ни хорошего, ни плохого».
reading.question: What warning did God give Laban in a dream?
options: Not to say anything to Jacob, good or bad
To kill Jacob for stealing his idols
To turn back and never pursue Jacob
To give Jacob half of his flocks
reading.correct: Not to say anything to Jacob, good or bad
reading.explain: God warned Laban in a dream not to speak to Jacob either good or bad.

reading.ru: Ты не дал мне даже поцеловать на прощание внуков и дочерей.
reading.question: What does Laban complain Jacob denied him?
options: The chance to kiss his grandchildren and daughters goodbye
The chance to bless Jacob's flocks
The right to keep the household idols
reading.correct: The chance to kiss his grandchildren and daughters goodbye
reading.explain: Laban complains that Jacob did not even let him kiss his grandchildren and daughters farewell.

reading.ru: Рахиль же взяла домашних башков, положила их в верблюжье седло и села на них.
reading.question: How did Rachel hide the household idols from Laban's search?
options: She put them in the camel's saddle and sat on them
She buried them outside the tent
She gave them to a servant to hide
She threw them into a river
reading.correct: She put them in the camel's saddle and sat on them
reading.explain: Rachel hid the idols by placing them in the camel's saddle and sitting on them.

reading.ru: Двадцать лет я прожил у тебя, твои овцы и козы не выкидывали, баранов из твоих стад я не ел.
reading.question: How does Jacob describe his twenty years of service to Laban?
options: He cared faithfully for the flocks without loss and did not eat from Laban's rams
He constantly lost sheep to wild animals
He complained he was never given enough food
He spent most of the time fighting with Laban's sons
reading.correct: He cared faithfully for the flocks without loss and did not eat from Laban's rams
reading.explain: Jacob recounts that during his twenty years of service, Laban's ewes and goats did not miscarry, and he did not eat the rams of the flock.

reading.ru: Давай же заключим договор, ты и я, и пусть он будет свидетельством между нами».
reading.question: What did Laban propose to Jacob after their argument?
options: That they make a covenant to serve as a witness between them
That Jacob return all his wages
That Rachel and Leah stay with Laban
That they fight to settle the dispute
reading.correct: That they make a covenant to serve as a witness between them
reading.explain: Laban proposes that he and Jacob make a covenant as a witness between them.

reading.ru: а рано утром Лаван поцеловал внуков и дочерей, благословил их и отправился домой.
reading.question: How does the chapter end?
options: Laban kisses his grandchildren and daughters, blesses them, and returns home
Jacob and Laban build a temple together
Rachel confesses to stealing the idols
reading.correct: Laban kisses his grandchildren and daughters, blesses them, and returns home
reading.explain: The chapter closes with Laban kissing his grandchildren and daughters, blessing them, and departing for home.
